                                                        SPARKLE Intel® Arc™ B580 TWIN, 12GB GDDR6, Torn Cooling 2.0, AXL Fan,
                                                        Metal Backplate，SB580S-12G

                                                    Th SPARKLE Intel® Arc™ B580 TWIN is designed for high-resolution gaming, featuring Intel® XeSS
                                                        AI upscaling, ray tracing, and 8K media support. It also accelerates AI-powered creation and
                                                        editing through Intel® AI Playground.
                                                        The TWIN Series is equipped with Torn Cooling 2.0, featuring 2 customized AXL fans, a 2.2-slot
                                                        design, and a full metal backplate.
